front_chirality.equal_index_condition: I(1)=I(-2)=I(4) iff B=C=0 (the q-linear and q² terms both vanish).
front_chirality.no_go_scope: Applies to one shared rank-r internal bundle E tensored with U1psi power L^q and the isolated 16+10+1 chiral census; distinct E bundles, inflow, broken gauge groups, or extra sectors evade it.
front_chirality.physical_boundary: An SU2 topological c2=-3 choice does not dynamically select 3, construct a stable gauge/HYM bundle, reproduce singular G2 compactification, fix Yukawas, or identify a physical vacuum.

front_noise.calibration_contract: IID independent accepted events, identical gain except bounded drift, bounded additive contrast bias, independently warranted unitary target, verified preparation trace-distance bound. Exact CP intervals for each arm combined by union bound.
front_noise.interpretation: An apparently excellent normalized-trace interference fringe can falsely certify centrality if the test-arm gain exceeds reference-arm gain. Independent drift bounds are essential.

front_physics_prediction.proof_obstruction: Same W33 incidence and same Z3 gauge group admit a continuous family of gauge-invariant actions with different Wilson expectations. No parameter-free coupling or Wilson expectation is selected by graph incidence alone.
front_physics_prediction.boundary: This is a finite graph single-plaquette Z3 lattice gauge counterexample, not the full dynamical W33 theory, nor experimental measurement. Choosing an additional action could select beta by a dynamical principle.

outside_box_dimensional_scale.scope: A dimensionful speed cannot be numerically determined by dimensionless finite combinatorial incidence without a calibrated length/time ratio or additional dynamics.

overall_scope: Executable standard quantum/math examples; no real lab, charged G2 index, unique action, or beyond-standard-model parameter-free observable.
